get_desc:
A rare splash of verdant green in the Starsea paints the world of <color=#ffd52e>Hexia</color>. Feel the gentle breeze whisper to its fertile earth, and savor the essence of all things in a cup of morning tea.

Departing from <color=#ffd52e>Hexia</color> on a Starsea Voyage, you may come across bamboo Islets where leaves dance on solar winds, or ride rice-scented tides toward peaceful paddy Islets.

The sands of fallen stars pave the grasslands of <color=#ffd52e>Taffeh</color>, and in its warmth, the afterglow of the stars. Thriving corn, mangoes, and sunflowers praise the endless wonders of this fabled land, where every dawn and dusk gleams with gold.

Departing from <color=#ffd52e>Taffeh</color> on a Starsea Voyage, you might encounter umbrella-crowned dragon blood trees, or plunge unexpectedly into the ancestral cornfields that have sustained this galaxy for generations.
